title: Sound publish E2E oracle: Ruffle visual verification for StartSound frame event
description:
The sound pipeline is wired model → SWF (packages/swf/src/sounds.ts, compile.ts line 1636-1638) and a sound envelope edit dialog was added (task 0769). However there is no Ruffle-based E2E test confirming that a published SWF with a frame sound actually produces audible output or changes stage state. Per CLAUDE.md: "byte-presence unit tests are not runtime proof".

## What to implement

Add apps/desktop/e2e/sound-roundtrip.spec.ts using the same fixture-build pattern as visual-oracle.spec.ts and button-roundtrip.spec.ts:

1. **Build a fixture SWF** with:
   - A 2-frame doc, background white frame 1, background red frame 2.
   - A SoundItem in the library (use a tiny inline WAV or MP3 data URI — a ~100-sample silence WAV generated in the test is enough).
   - A StartSound on frame 1 and a stop-all on frame 2 (or just gotoAndStop(2) from an onEnterFrame).
   - The goal is NOT to verify audio plays (headless Ruffle has no audio output) — rather to verify that the SWF compiles without errors and Ruffle does not crash/blank-screen when a StartSound tag is present.

2. **Ruffle smoke test**: load the SWF into Ruffle (same iframe injection as bitmap-rendering.spec.ts) and assert:
   - The player loads without panic (no "panic" overlay visible).
   - Frame 1 renders a non-blank stage (pixel diff vs white reference > threshold).
   - The stage screenshot at frame 1 matches a stored baseline (red vs white, or just the non-blank assertion is sufficient for first pass).

3. **Envelope encoding smoke**: also build a second SWF with a customEnvelope (inPoint, outPoint, two envelope points) and assert it compiles and loads without Ruffle panic.

## Why this matters
The existing sounds.ts encoder writes StartSound and SoundInfo structs; if any length or flag is wrong (precedent: the AllEventFlags reserved UI16 bug in clip actions), Ruffle silently discards the block without crashing — but the SWF would be broken. An E2E oracle would catch this.

## Acceptance
- New spec runs in CI (not skipped).
- Ruffle loads the sound SWF and renders a non-blank first frame.
- Ruffle loads the envelope SWF without panic.
